summary: Pydantic models for dimension configuration: Dimension (per-dimension spec) and DimensionsMetadata (collection with uniqueness validation).

key_classes.name: Dimension
key_classes.summary: Declares one rule dimension: name, match_strategy, data_type, role, range fields, regex_pattern. Validated by Pydantic model_validator.

key_classes.name: DimensionsMetadata
key_classes.summary: Ordered list of Dimension objects with uniqueness validation; entry point for engine construction.

extension_points: Adding a new MatchStrategy requires a matching validation branch in Dimension._validate_strategy_fields.
lifecycle_notes: RANGE strategy requires range_min_field and range_max_field; numeric data_type is enforced.
REGEX strategy requires regex_pattern on the Dimension (not per-row in the rules DataFrame).
documentation_hooks: The resolved_context_field / resolved_rule_field properties control name remapping — document this for users who want separate context/rule column names.
Pydantic validation errors are the primary user-facing error surface for misconfigured dimensions.
open_questions: REGEX pattern is metadata-level (one pattern per dimension). Per-row patterns are not supported; document this limitation.
